subject: Interest in Redwood trial & demo — FastRetail sign-up
messages:
From: Jessica Nguyen <jessica.nguyen@fastretail.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-15 09:12 -0700
Subject: Redwood trial/sign-up — interest in demo

Hi Karthik,

I just signed up for the Redwood self-serve trial and saw the note about scheduling a quick demo. We're evaluating inference platforms to power a shopper personalization feature (recommendations + short product blurbs). I work on the platform team at FastRetail and will be the primary point of contact.

Quick context:
- Use case: real-time product description generation + lightweight personalization snippets in web & mobile
- Traffic expectation: 100–200k API calls/day initially (spiky during campaigns), average prompt size ~150 tokens
- Timeline: pilot in 6–8 weeks, production roll-out by Q3

Attached a short doc with our compliance checklist and a few integration questions. Could we do a 30-minute call next week to walk through fit and any gating items (SLA, data residency)?

Thanks,
Jessica Nguyen
Platform Engineer, FastRetail
[jessica.nguyen@fastretail.com]

Attachment: fastretail-initial-product-questions.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Jessica Nguyen <jessica.nguyen@fastretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-15 09:37 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood trial/sign-up — interest in demo

Thanks for signing up and for the context, Jessica — great use case. I'm Karthik on the sales team; looping in Marissa from Customer Success for the SLA/data residency questions. A few quick items to help us tailor the demo:

1) Expected latency SLO (p95) for the personalization snippets?
2) Are the calls synchronous from the frontend or routed through a backend service?
3) Any specific regulatory constraints (e.g., PCI scope concerns, EU data residency) beyond the checklist you attached?
4) Do you expect to persist generated outputs server-side, or only transiently in caches?

I can do a 30-minute slot next week on Tue/Wed between 9–11am PT or Thu 1–4pm PT. If those don't work, send a few times that do and I'll book.

If useful, here's a quick pre-read on how we handle production inference for low-latency workloads: https://redwood.ai/docs/production-inference-low-latency

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0142

From: Jessica Nguyen <jessica.nguyen@fastretail.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-15 10:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood trial/sign-up — interest in demo

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick reply — answers below: 

1) Latency: target p95 ~120–150ms for web snippets, but we can tolerate up to 250ms for non-critical pages.
2) Calls: routed through our backend (Node) service — frontend never directly calls the model.
